text: 8月30日上午，国家主席习近平乘专机离开北京，赴比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会，应吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫、埃及总统塞西邀请对两国进行国事访问。陪同习近平出访的有：习近平主席夫人彭丽媛，中共中央政治局常委、中央办公厅主任蔡奇，中共中央政治局委员、外交部部长王毅等。（新华社）
text_en: On the morning of August 30, President Xi Jinping left Beijing by special plane for Bishkek to attend the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit, and paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Japarov and Egyptian President Sisi. Accompanying Xi on the trip were Peng Liyuan, wife of President Xi Jinping, Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and director of the General Office, and Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, among others. (Xinhua)
